blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur – Fire struck four houses in Barangay Nalbo in Laoag City, Ilocos Norte on Friday. No casualties reported, local authorities said. According to Laoag City Vice Mayor Carlos Fariñas, the fire was reported to him at 6:52 a.m. via a Facebook Messenger call from a resident in the area. Fariñas said they immediately proceeded to the scene and arrived at 7:01 a.m. The fire was placed under control at around 7:30 a.m., the vice mayor said.
